message.content:
Here are some **art collaborations from 2023** that show up in the provided results:

- **Co/LAB 2023** at the Torrance Art Museum was an annual international emerging-artists collaborative project pairing four artist-run galleries from around the world with four Southern California artist-run galleries to present four collaborative exhibitions.[1]
- The participating spaces included **Kalashnikovv Gallery** with **Wonzimer**, **Fosforita** with **Durden and Ray**, **Supermarket** with **515**, and **Space One** with **Tiger Strikes Asteroid**.[1]
- The featured artists listed for that project included **Carlos Beltrán**, **Gul Cagin**, **Lan Duong**, **Le Frére**, **Ben Jackel**, **Javier Jimeno**, **Ty Pownall**, **Eva Zaragozá**, and **Irene Zóttola**.[1]
- In 2023, the **Dunn Lab** collaborated on a **Bioscience** publication about how organisms prepare food, and artist **Eleanor Quist Olson** created a painting to visually represent the publication.[2]
- The Dunn Lab also notes an ongoing collaboration with the **Center for Genomic Gastronomy** on the **Wildfire Loaf Project**, which was already in the ideation stage in their 2023-related collaboration notes.[2]
- **Art Collaboration Kyoto 2023** took place at the Kyoto International Conference Center from **October 28–30, 2023**.[5]
